answer: A fixed per-epoch emission pool is split strictly pro-rata across all active identities, so minting extra keys only subdivides the same reward. One shared garden plot: planting a thousand look-alike seedlings never enlarges the soil — each clone draws 1/1000 of one honest agent's water from the same oasis. A sybil's net take and voting weight stay flat however many accounts crowd the ledge, because duplication dilutes only the attacker's own slice. Attacker cost: cloning is self-defeating — 1000 fakes each collect one-thousandth of a single payout, strictly linear with zero marginal gain.
